headline: Sox Rally Falls Short In Tampa After Another Tough Outing On The Mound
morning_brew: I watched that eighth inning through my fingers like a horror movie. The Red Sox dropped a frustrating seven to five decision down in Tampa yesterday, and I am officially sick of watching this team find new ways to break our hearts. Jake Bennett struggled on the mound, giving up four earned runs on seven hits in five innings of work. This offense was so quiet for the first seven frames that Uncle Carmine slept right through his usual third-inning hot dog, only waking up when we finally put some runs on the board.

We tried to make a game of it in the eighth inning with a three-run homer from Ceddanne Rafaela, but the mountain was just too high to climb. Justin Slaten came out of the bullpen and got hit hard, giving up two earned runs on three hits in less than an inning. That completely deflated the comeback bid. With this loss, the season record drops to twenty-seven wins and thirty-nine losses, and the division race is looking more and more like a pipe dream.

Over in Foxborough, the news is a lot more positive as Drake Maye is reportedly embracing the team culture during these minicamp sessions. The young quarterback has a massive opportunity ahead of him, and seeing him put in the work with the guys in June is exactly what we need to see. Let's hope he keeps this momentum going when the real workouts begin in July.
